_comment: PROVIDER PLUG-IN for the `sca` role — one of several; the institution chooses. This one closes a specific hole: scripts/supply-chain-check.mjs reads dependency-audit.json from a path the coding agent can write, so an agent that writes {"critical":0,"high":0} goes green without a scan. That is the HG-0002 failure mode. The provider makes the counts an envelope the SCANNER ORG asserts, signed by an issuer outside the agent's write scope (governance/attestation-issuers.template.json), and reconciled against the file the gate reads. To adopt: record the choice in docs/governance/provider-selection.json, copy this file to docs/governance/adapters/, point it at your org, and wire the fetch that fills activation_evidence.
capability: The scanner org's own severity counts for the scanned project, plus the reachability verdict behind any deferred finding — asserted by the platform, not by the repository under test

reconciliation._comment: The gate reads the file; the adapter proves the file matches the platform. Reconcile on scanned_commit AND on every count — a stale or edited local report is a finding, not a pass.

activation_evidence._comment: ADOPT: fill from a real API read against your Snyk org + a tamper probe; sign the envelope with a registry issuer. The tamper probe is the decisive one — it proves the RECONCILIATION bites, not that the API answered.
activation_evidence.fetched_at: ADOPT: timestamp of your Snyk API read
activation_evidence.scanner_identity: ADOPT: the least-privilege service account that runs the scan — must NOT be the coding agent's identity
activation_evidence.tamper_probe: ADOPT: 'rejected' once you have tested that editing dependency-audit.json away from the platform's counts fails the build
